en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1997 - Al-Halabi narrated from Abu Abdullah (as):

"If a man has missed fasts from the Month of Ramadan, he may make them up in any month he wishes, in consecutive days. If he is unable to do so, he may make them up as he is able, counting the days. Whether he separates the days or fasts them consecutively, both are acceptable."
